title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Frame Parser Work Item
summary: Add a reusable RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 frame parser and message reassembler without opening application handler dispatch.
planned_changes:
- Add typed WebSocket opcodes, frame records, message records, deterministic frame formatting, and an incremental message reader under `Incursa.Quic.Http3`.
- Enforce endpoint-role masking policy for client-to-server and server-to-client frames.
- Reassemble fragmented text and binary messages across continuation frames.
- Validate continuation ordering, end-of-stream completeness, and control-frame finality and payload-size constraints.
- Add focused requirement-home tests, fuzz-harness coverage, and BenchmarkDotNet parser coverage.
verification_plan: Run the focused WebSocket message-reader tests, build the fuzz project to prove harness wiring, run a BenchmarkDotNet dry run for the WebSocket parser benchmarks, validate SpecTrace JSON, regenerate QUIC requirement triage, and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Bidirectional tunnel forwarding between HTTP/3 streams and application code.
Close status-code parsing and close-handshake policy.
QUIC transport runtime, packet protection, ACK, recovery, or stream-state changes.
completion_notes: The HTTP/3 adapter now has a trace-owned WebSocket frame parser and message reassembler that can be consumed by later handler-integration work.
